items.quote: Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth
Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying
items.claim: Ephron the Hittite publicly responded to Abraham
items.place: in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city

items.quote: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee
items.claim: Ephron offered to give Abraham a field with a cave in the presence of his people
items.object: the field and the cave that is therein
items.place: in the presence of the sons of my people
